'''Alus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]].

==Biography==
By the time Empress [[Vaylin]] took the [[Eternal Throne]], Alus was an initiate training to join the ranks of the [[Knights of Zakuul]]. During the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]] he was present in the [[Palace of the Eternal Dragon]] barracks along with several Knights when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Frem]] told the story of [[Watcher Izax]]. Vaylin's speech was interrupted by the arrival of first [[Alliance Commander]] and then former Emperor [[Arcann]]. In an effort to kill them both, Vaylin ordered the [[Eternal Fleet]] to bomb the Palace into rubble, regardless of her supporters still inside.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Initiate Alus appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during "Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw."
